adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 43.8. Memorial Day (Mon) is a known driver, with a past event multiplier of x1.66 (2025), though the noise-adjusted estimate is x1.0 due to limited data. The 2024 Memorial Day week included a 15% discount, confounding the pure event effect. No promotion is planned this week (price unchanged at $13.38), and the prior week (Mother's Day) saw a lift to x1.30 vs baseline. The uplift model suggests no change, but past data shows Memorial Day typically lifts sales. Given the single clean past occurrence (2025), the effect is uncertain. We shrink toward 1.0. The price is unchanged, so no price effect. No evidence of pantry loading or supply risk. The spread remains baseline-wide.
